scope: Bind each typed DWG-origin entity group-8 layer name to its source common-header LAYER hard-pointer and the exact LAYER row emitted by the current DXF write attempt.

implementation.sourceProfile: ODA v5.4.1 section 20.4.2 defines the entity LAYER relationship as a hard-pointer. The entity retains the resolved 32-bit handle, original 64-bit value and raw handle role for strict output admission.
implementation.stagedOutput: The TABLES inspector maps every typed source DRW_Layer to its current emitted handle and qualified LAYER row, requiring unique source handles, emitted handles and names. It recognizes the writer's fixed synthetic layer-0 row only when the source model has no layer 0; that row is never entered in the source-binding map.
implementation.entityAdmission: Before typed entity serialization, require a nonzero/non-sentinel source handle, exact raw 64-bit equality, DwgHardPointer role, exact entity/source layer-name equality and a still-current source-to-emitted LAYER binding. Apply the same check recursively to embedded POLYLINE VERTEX/SEQEND and INSERT ATTRIB/SEQEND records.
implementation.finalization: Retain source and emitted LAYER bindings through write finalization and recheck the target registry after OBJECTS callbacks. A changed or ambiguous table alias fails the file transaction.
implementation.compatibility: No callback or virtual API changed. DRW_Entity gains additive inline DWG layer-handle accessors and a raw wire-state setter; no data members or vtable slots were added. Tolerant read behavior remains unchanged.

validation.result: Build passed with -Werror. Focused fast CTest passed 1/1 in 1.51 seconds. The generated AC1024 adapter graph ran 27 profiles for each of seven DXF targets (AC1014, AC1015, AC1018, AC1021, AC1024, AC1027, AC1032) in ASCII and Binary: four positive explicit/implicit-linetype profiles and 23 negative profiles. The negative matrix includes wrong source name, missing/null/wide/wrong-role/wrong-kind entity LAYER references and post-inspection source-to-output alias mutation. Every refusal preserved the destination and succeeded on same-codec retry; positive files read back exact entity group-8 layer names. Recursive embedded VERTEX checks cover valid, name-mismatched and wrong-kind references.
validation.fixtures: No DWG/DXF fixture was added or modified. DXF outputs were generated in a temporary directory and removed by the test.

limitations: Generated AC1024 adapter evidence only; no physical whole-source DWG conversion reached this gate.
Raw-preserved DXF entity references, producer ordering, whole-document closure, native application behavior and linetype rendering remain unqualified.
This does not qualify nondefault owner, reactor, extension-dictionary, color, material, plotstyle, visual-style or EED references.

files.src/drw_entities.h: exposes the retained entity LAYER handle value and role and provides a setter for exact wire state
files.dwg2dxf/dx_iface.h: retains source-to-emitted LAYER bindings for the write transaction
files.dwg2dxf/dx_iface.cpp: inspects emitted TABLES rows, checks typed entity and embedded-entity references, and revalidates bindings at finalization
files.tests/dxf_symbol_output_tests.cpp: adds generated ASCII/Binary matrix, failure/retry, alias-mutation and readback controls
files.DWG_DXF_OPEN_SOURCE_PARITY_PLAN.md: records this completed local slice and keeps physical/raw/native gates open
